honesty_alpha_implications: WINDOW B IS THE CLEAN TEST: Pre-COVID normal cycle with ONE major default event in the window (Verity Aug 2018). Framework should flag Verity with high confidence at 2017-12-31 via MA leverage + going-concern + operating-loss detectors.

VERITY IS THE TRUE POSITIVE: With $175M annual losses and BlueMountain 2015 leveraged transition visible at 2017, framework's 4-signal stack should fire. This is a textbook DETECTABLE pre-default scenario.
REST OF UNIVERSE IS CLEAN BASELINE: 14 of 18 obligors had no event AND no signal — framework correctly leaves them alone. Validates low false-positive rate in normal cycle.

WEAK SIGNALS ON LATER-DEFAULTERS: Framework's signals on CNMH/Eskaton/St. Anne's at 2017 are weak because in-window financial deterioration not yet visible. This is HONEST: framework cannot predict events 3-4 years out from non-deteriorating financials.

COMPARISON TO WINDOW A: Window B has 2 defaults vs Window A's 3 defaults (Verity in both as default-precursor). Window A has covenant breach (Eskaton FY2022) which Window B does not. Window A is harder test because COVID-stressed many CA NH operators simultaneously.

FRAMEWORK SIGNAL DENSITY: Window B = 1 in-window event with strong 2017 signals (Verity). Window A = 1 NEW in-window event with weaker 2019 signals (CNMH) + 1 covenant breach (Eskaton) + 1 operational stress (Atherton, no bond event). Window A is a richer test.
